items.raw_excerpt: Sweden's education system is built on a very different philosophy from those of many other countries, with less focus on who is top of the class, and more focus on group cooperation and life skills. We asked readers of The Local what they made of it.
items.summary_en: Sweden's schools focus more on group cooperation and life skills than competition. Foreign parents living in Sweden shared their thoughts on this different approach to education.
items.summary_ko: 스웨덴의 학교는 경쟁보다 협동과 생활 기술을 더 중시하는 교육 철학을 가지고 있습니다. 스웨덴에 살고 있는 외국인 학부모들은 이러한 교육 방식에 대해 각자의 의견을 전했습니다.
items.title_en: What foreign parents think about schools in Sweden
items.title_ko: 스웨덴 학교에 대한 외국인 학부모들의 생각
items.title_original: 'Students have it so soft': What foreign parents think of schools in Sweden

items.raw_excerpt: Dutch flying car maker PAL-V has been given the go-ahead to start building something that could be in the skies in 2028. The European aviation safety agency EASA gave the company, based in Noord-Brabant, a production licence, meaning it now has every permit it needs to begin building. It first began designing flying cars 20 years ago. “Now that EASA approval is in, we will really start producing the first cars soon,” chief executive Robert Dingemanse told broadcaster NOS. “We...
items.summary_en: A Dutch company called PAL-V has received approval from European aviation authorities to begin building flying cars. The company, based in Noord-Brabant, has been working on the design for 20 years and aims to have cars in the skies by 2028. CEO Robert Dingemanse said production will start soon now that all permits are in place.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드의 PAL-V라는 회사가 유럽 항공당국으로부터 비행 자동차 생산 허가를 받았다. 20년간 설계를 작업해 온 이 회사는 노르트브라반트주에 본사를 두고 있으며 2028년 하늘을 날 계획이다. CEO 로버트 딩거만스는 모든 허가가 완료되면 곧 생산을 시작할 것이라고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Dutch flying car maker gets green light to start production
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 비행 자동차 제조사, 생산 시작 허가 획득

items.raw_excerpt: Vimala College students launch 'V-Weave,' a sericulture start-up transforming silkworms into silk sarees, fostering entrepreneurship and sustainability.
items.summary_en: Students of Vimala College in Thrissur launched 'V-Weave,' a sericulture start-up. They turn silkworms into silk sarees. The project supports entrepreneurship and sustainability.

items.title_en: Students in Thrissur start a silk start-up

items.raw_excerpt: Colégio Militar Metro Station, on Lisbon’s Blue Line, is located next to the Colombo shopping centre and Colégio Militar. The station combines modern design with artwork that reflects Lisbon’s tradition of bringing culture into everyday public spaces.
items.summary_en: Colégio Militar metro station sits on Lisbon's Blue Line next to the Colombo shopping centre. The station blends modern design with artwork that brings culture into everyday public spaces. It is a small, pleasant piece of local life in Lisbon.
items.summary_ko: 콜레지우 밀리타르 지하철역은 리스본 블루 라인의 콜롬보 쇼핑센터 옆에 있다. 이 역은 현대적인 디자인과 예술 작품을 함께 담아 일상 공간에 문화를 더한다. 리스본의 작고 정겨운 지역 생활을 보여 주는 곳이다.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan Lottery will add NT$400 million (US$12.57 million) in prizes to three popular games for a Mid-Autumn Festival promotion, including 70 additional NT$1 million prizes for its Lotto 6/49 game, the company said Tuesday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan Lottery will add NT$400 million in prizes to three games for the Mid-Autumn Festival. This includes 70 extra NT$1 million prizes for the Lotto 6/49 game.

items.raw_excerpt: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has asked Israeli ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm to be more serious about instructing Israeli tourists to respect Thai culture and traditions, to protect bilateral ties.
items.summary_en: Thailand's foreign minister has asked the Israeli ambassador to make sure Israeli tourists follow Thai customs and traditions. The minister said this is important to keep good relations between the two countries. The request came after reports of disrespectful behavior by some Israeli visitors.
items.summary_ko: 태국 외무장관이 이스라엘 대사에게 자국 관광객들이 태국 관습과 전통을 존중하도록 지시해 달라고 요청했습니다. 양국 관계 유지를 위해 중요한 사안이라고 강조했습니다. 일부 이스라엘 관광객의 무례한 행동 보도 이후 나온 요청입니다.
items.title_en: Thailand asks Israel to remind tourists to respect Thai culture
